title: WEDM Frontend Closure — R5 Codex-Alignment Gaps
philosophy: Round 5 scrutiny (researcher + code-analyzer + Plan, 2026-04-16) measured Codex-built frontend against the WEDM backend spine and found 7 WEDM-specific gaps: (1) WireEdmStudioPage 6-step wizard = ~5,862 LOC of Codex scaffolding (WizardShell + ProfileCanvas + 6 Step components + WedmStudioContext + useWedmPipeline) is the cleanest vertical but has no maintenance gate, (2) CalculatorPage wire_edm mode-switch leaks tool/material/operation state, (3) 4 hardcoded 'fanuc-wire-standard' defaults risk breakage on registry rename, (4) no 'Print Drop' frontend bridge page that auto-dispatches CAD/PDF to /wire-edm-studio, (5) jobId-via-URL handoff fails for multi-op jobs (mill->WEDM), (6) WEDM-relevant orphan API clients (feasibility, toolpath, cadGeometry, edmFeatures) unused, (7) WireEdmStudioPage (/wire-edm 6-step) and WireEdmWizardPage (/wire-edm-wizard single-page, APPW-MS0 tagged, solveWireEdmWizard API) are parallel wizards with unclear purpose split — risking user confusion and forked maintenance. This milestone closes WEDM's share of those 7 gaps without duplicating Universal Phase 0 work.

reference: mcp-server/web/src/pages/WireEdmStudioPage.tsx (121 LOC wrapper, /wire-edm route, canonical 6-step wizard host)
mcp-server/web/src/pages/WireEdmWizardPage.tsx (183 LOC, /wire-edm-wizard single-page quick planner, appw_stage: 'APPW-MS0 machining calculation')
mcp-server/data/milestones/APPW-MS0.json (App Full-Stack Wiring — binds appw_stage tags)
